column1: # Book-derived live probes, ranked. book_baseline: tests/conformance/book/baseline.tsv for the

column11: why

The test refuses (3512) a <transacts> caller of a function with no specifiers; ch. 13 calls the default almost <transacts>. OpenVerse accepts. Decides the default effect, which every probe and #515 depend on.
Is a subclass of a <concrete> class concrete? The tests say yes (3519); OpenVerse accepts. The open owner decision on the wiki.
Control: the same classes with a default for the subclass field (the Book's :3 accepts the <concrete> base alone).

column10: ran: query value differs from false
column11: The tests give true? the empty value; ch. 8 says a query succeeds with the queried value. OpenVerse follows ch. 8 here.
VerseVM integers are arbitrary precision (docs/02_primitives.md); OpenVerse stops with an overflow. With int-overflow, decides whether OpenVerse needs bignums for the shipped VM.
Overflow through set +=, a separate code path from the binary operator.
VerseVM refuses at link time (9003) a module constant whose construction allocates a var; OpenVerse accepts.
